title: CapabilityVectorBinding
description: DD-124(2): one substitution position of a V2 step. pointer is an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the step input (INPUT) or expected output (EXPECTED); the literal there must be exactly the reserved placeholder {{SOURCE:key}}. INPUT may bind PRECONDITION or CAPTURE; EXPECTED may bind CAPTURE or a PRECONDITION already sent as INPUT in this case. The plan digest fixes the declaration, never the value.
